rental_checklist.persistence: Keep source checkout, runtime prefix, caches, run root and checkpoints on a provider-retained mounted volume. Process detachment cannot survive machine destruction; provider retention requires operator verification.
rental_checklist.licenses: Read Isaac and model licenses before using acceptance flags. Cosmos-Reason2 gated Hugging Face access must already be granted for optional model acquisition. No credentials are placed in command arguments.

execution_rules.default: execution stages default to dry-run without subprocesses, downloads or CUDA execution. Doctor/report perform bounded read-only subprocess inspections.
execution_rules.qualification: one successful raw-verified startup scene per arm, then frozen 20 scenes/arm and existing 18/20 physical gate
execution_rules.collection: 10..20 successful train demos per arm (default 12), plus six expert validation/evaluation demonstrations each. All failed attempts retained. These expert export splits are not learned-policy scorecards.
execution_rules.g3: local pinned model/runtime preflight before paid simulation dependencies; two A optimizer steps/reload, projector and normalizer conversion, two B optimizer steps/reload, three real validation closed-loop scenes
execution_rules.m0: separate bounded source training (default 2000 steps, effective batch 12), fifty frozen held-out trials with no fallback and three validation layouts each with all three instruction colors; 25/50 plus all nine diagnostics required. Completed FAIL is retained and never automatically re-evaluated.
execution_rules.initial_safety_failures: first-action rejection and partial-tick physical safety stops count as failures; successful demonstrations retain uniform cadence and terminal stability requirements
execution_rules.restart: use identical commands; completed stages rehash and revalidate. Interrupted installs retry only unfinished operations. Active inherited leases block duplicate processes. An incomplete held-out evaluation is preserved and requires investigation before a new predeclared run.
execution_rules.bounds: default pipeline deadline 28800 seconds, trial timeout 2400 seconds, two outer attempts; configuration is frozen. Training requires a separate consent flag. No cloud APIs are called.
execution_rules.containers: base image build prepares OS/uv and copies code without accepting Isaac licenses or starting runtime setup; invoke setup on the GPU host after container launch
execution_rules.shutdown: SIGTERM/SIGHUP enter process-tree cleanup and preserve an atomic interruption receipt. Detached execution survives SSH disconnection; active orphan leases prevent unsafe duplicate launches.

artifact_layout.runtime: prefix/deployment and prefix/setup: install attempts, logs, package inventories, runtime fingerprints and native library hash; prefix/cache and prefix/{robot_cache,assets,models}: persistent dependencies
artifact_layout.scripted: root/session/smoke, qualification and pilot: raw images, samples, telemetry, outcomes, rejected scenes, dataset exports and reader receipts
artifact_layout.g3: root/g3: source optimizer attempts, B initialization, target optimizer attempts, checkpoint service and real closed-loop action traces
artifact_layout.m0: root/campaign/models/a, train_a and m0_evaluate_a: source checkpoints, held-out report, execution/perception traces and separate counterfactual report
artifact_layout.orchestration: root/pipeline: immutable process attempts, completed artifact hashes, report history; root/detached: console logs and launch receipts

failure_diagnostics: Inspect pipeline/report.json first, then the failed stage process.log/process.json/result.json. Missing runtimes require setup; changed source/configuration requires a new root; corrupt completed evidence blocks reuse. Never delete failures to improve a score.
